items.t: Timing chain rattle
items.job: Replace timing chain kit (chain, tensioner, guides)
items.note: OutMotoring puts it at roughly $500-$900 labor plus $150-$450 parts.

items.t: Water pump leak
items.job: Replace water pump
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $670-$950 for a 2011-2016 Countryman.

items.t: Thermostat or thermostat housing failure
items.job: Replace thermostat and housing
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $550-$770 for a 2014-2016 Countryman.

items.t: Cracked oil filter housing leaking oil and coolant
items.job: Replace oil filter housing and gaskets
items.note: Cost rises if the wiring harness has been damaged by oil.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump failure
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump

items.t: Turbo oil feed line leak
items.job: Replace turbo oil feed line and seals

items.t: Oil leak from VANOS or oil pump solenoid
items.job: Replace leaking solenoid and seal

items.t: Misfires from failing ignition coils
items.job: Replace ignition coil and spark plugs

items.t: Valve cover gasket or crankcase vent leak
items.job: Replace valve cover and gasket

items.t: Cranks but will not start (eccentric shaft wear)
items.job: Replace eccentric shaft sensor or Valvetronic parts
items.note: A sensor alone is the low end; worn shaft parts cost more.

items.t: Front differential failure (ALL4)
items.job: Replace front differential
items.note: A used unit lowers the cost.

items.t: Footwell module failure: lights, windows and signals stop working
items.job: Replace and program footwell module (FRM)
items.note: One owner was quoted $921 at a dealer.

items.t: Water leaks into the cabin from clogged sunroof drains
items.job: Clear sunroof drains and dry the interior
items.note: Replacing water-damaged modules costs far more.

items.t: Door handle breaks and door will not open or close
items.job: Replace exterior door handle and cable

items.t: Clutch or dual-mass flywheel wear (manual)
items.job: Replace clutch kit and flywheel

items.t: Rear tires wear on the inside edges
items.job: Replace rear control arms or bushings and align

items.t: Front strut mount worn: clunk and one side sits low
items.job: Replace front strut mounts (pair) and align

items.t: Rear hatch will not open or pops open
items.job: Replace hatch release switch

items.t: Hood scoop warps from turbo heat
items.job: Replace hood scoop

items.t: Cowl trim near the wipers cracks
items.job: Replace cowl trim panels

items.t: Tire pressure warning light stays on
items.job: Diagnose and reset tire pressure system

items.t: Headlight washers stop working
items.job: Repair headlamp washer pump or line

items.t: Brake pads wear quickly
items.job: Front brake pads, rotors and wear sensor
